name: Guadramiro (Spain)
description: Square flag with a red stripe along the hoist with an embattled edge and a blue fly charged with the crowned municipal arms of Guadramiro (a tower on white and fleurs-de-lis on red).
history: The municipal flag of Guadramiro was approved on 7 September 2007, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 3 October 2007; it is square, of proportions 1/1, formed of a blue cloth with a red embattled stripe at the hoist, the municipal arms centred on the blue stripe.
